title: pekarj/bdbv-pipeline-temp
description: Automated pipeline for downloading, cleaning, and building maximum-likelihood phylogenies from Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV) genome sequences hosted on Pathoplexus.

input_options.title: Input Options
input_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

fasta.title: FASTA
fasta.help_text: pre-aligned from Pathoplexus, or unaligned if using --mafft

output_options.title: Output Options
output_options.description: Parameters for saving and naming workflow outputs.

outdir.title: Output folder name
outdir.description: Directory for output of all user-facing files.

advanced_options.title: Advanced Options
advanced_options.description: Advanced options for configuring processes inside the workflow.

mafft.title: Run MAFFT alignment
mafft.help_text: Run MAFFT alignment before cleaning (skip if sequences are already aligned from Pathoplexus)

aliases_file.title: Aliases file
aliases_file.description: Path to the aliases CSV file.

adar_mode.title: ADAR mode
adar_mode.help_text: ADAR handling: mask sites, exclude T>C genomes, or exclude T>C/A>G/G>A genomes.

exclude_file.title: Exclude file
exclude_file.description: Identity exclusions (non-consortium, same-patient duplicates): excluded from everything.

exclude_quality.title: Exclude quality file
exclude_quality.description: Quality exclusions (low-quality sequences): excluded from phylogenetics only.

outlier_removal_threshold.title: Outlier removal threshold
outlier_removal_threshold.help_text: Auto-remove outliers with |z| >= this threshold (e.g. 3.0) and skip manual review

model.title: Model
model.help_text: Use this substitution model (e.g. GTR+F+R3) instead of running ModelFinder

beast_template.title: BEAST template
beast_template.description: Path to the BEAST template XML file.

miscellaneous_options.title: Miscellaneous Options
miscellaneous_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.
